chapters: Na pai' dhuuk cham tu'x jai'ch ka't, gu Jawatan Dios jix duu gu tɨkɨr gio gu oidha'.
Gio gu oidha' cham tu'x bhaan ka't gio jix tukgam, gio gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios jix mii'ñdhix bhaan gu suudai'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios: «Na jix tasi' ka'», gio ba' jix tasi' jum duu.
Gio gu Jawatan Dios jix ñi' gu tasi' na jix bhai' ka't; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix ai'chdhix gu tasi' gio gu tukgam.
Gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jup tɨɨt Tanoolh gu tasi', gio gu tukgam jup tɨɨt Tukaa'; gio ba' xumai jum duu gio xibh jum duu, maa'n tanoolh.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' ka't gu tɨkɨr tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' jix ai'chdhix gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨkɨr jix ai'chdhix gu suudai' mi'p bɨtaa'n gu tɨkɨr gu suudai' mi'p bhaan gu tɨkɨr; gio ba' ka't.
Gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jup tɨɨt Tɨkɨr gu tɨkɨr; gio ba' xumai jum duu gio xibh jum duu, gook tanoolh.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jum daa'ñ gu suudai' bɨtaa'n gu tɨkɨr pai' jix ñi'ñ jix gaki; mi' dhɨr ka't.
Gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jup tɨɨt Oidha' gu jix gaki oidha', gio gu suudai' na jum daa'ñ jup tɨɨt Gɨ' Suudai'; gio gu Jawatan Dios jix ñi' na jix bhai' ka't.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix buusñi gu oidha' gu vaas jix maa gu kai'; mi' dhɨr gu u'u gu i'bhɨ jix maa gu i'bhɨ bhaan na jax chu'm gu kai' bhaan gu oidha'; jano' ba' ka't.
Jano' ba' jix buusñi gu oidha' gu vaas jix maa gu kai' bhaan na jax chu'm gu u'u jix maa gu i'bhɨ gu kai' bhaan na jax chu'm; gio ba' jix ñi' gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu xumai gu xibh gu tanoolh vaik.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios: «Na jai'ch ka' gu tasi' tɨkɨr bhaan gu tɨkɨr na ba' jix ai'chdhix gu tanoolh gio gu tukaa', na ba' ka't pai' dhuuk gio gu tanoolh».
Gio na ka't gu tasi' tɨkɨr bhaan gu tɨkɨr na ba' jix tas duu bhaan gu oidha'; gio ba' ja'p jum duu.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Jawatan Dios gook jix gɨ' tasi' tɨkɨr, gu jix gɨ' tas na jix gɨ'kora' bhaan gu tanoolh, gio gu masad na jix ali' na jix gɨ'kora' bhaan gu tukaa', gio gu si'avag.
Gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix dhaas bhaan gu tɨkɨr na ba' jix tas duu bhaan gu oidha'.
Gio na jix gɨ'kora' bhaan gu tanoolh gio bhaan gu tukaa', gio na jix ai'chdhix gu tasi' gio gu tukgam; gio gu Jawatan Dios jix ñi' na jix bhai' ka't.
Gio ba' xumai jum duu gio xibh jum duu, maakobh tanoolh.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix buusñi gu suudai' gu ko'oi gu i'ii'ñ na jix do'ig gu u'uvhig da'a bhaan gu oidha' jix kupi'ook gu tɨkɨr.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bɨx guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu suudai' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhaan na jax chu'm bɨx gu u'uvhig guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bhaan na jax chu'm; gio ba' jix ñi' gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix bhai'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios jix bhai' aa' bham; gio ba' jix maa gu i'bhɨ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jix bhuup gu suudai' gu gɨ' suudai' gu u'uvhig guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu xumai gu xibh gu tanoolh jixchamaam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix buusñi gu oidha' gu i'ii'ñ na jix do'ig bhaan na jax chu'm gu vaakax gu ko'oi gu vaakax gu oidha' bhaan na jax chu'm; mi' dhɨr ka't.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu Jawatan Dios gu vaakax gu oidha' bhaan na jax chu'm gu vaakax bhaan na jax chu'm bɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bhaan gu oidha' bhaan na jax chu'm; gio ba' jix ñi' gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix bhai'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix duu gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat na jax chu'm jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat na jax chu'm; mi' dhɨr jix gɨ'kora' gu vatop gu gɨ' suudai' gu u'uvhig gu tɨkɨr gu vaakax bɨx gu oidha' bɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bhaan gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Jawatan Dios gu chio'ñ na jax chu'm gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ jix duu.

Ba' jix aa' jix bhai' aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr jix maa gu i'bhɨ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jix bhuup gu oidha' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bhaan gu vatop gu gɨ' suudai' gu u'uvhig gu tɨkɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu vaakax oidha' bhaan jiim bhaan pai'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jix maa bɨx gu vaas jix maa gu kai' bhaan gu vupui bɨx gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr bɨx gu u'u cham tu'x jai'ch gu i'bhɨ gu u'u jix maa gu kai' ka't na ba' jugi.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu vaakax gu oidha' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu u'uvhig gu tɨkɨr bɨx oidha' bhaan jiim bhaan pai' cham tu'x jai'ch pai' bɨx gu vaas ka't na ba' jugi; gio ba' ka't.
Jano' ba' jix ñi' gu Jawatan Dios bɨx ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ka't jix bhai'; gio ba' ka't gu xumai gu xibh gu tanoolh xijumai.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook gu tɨkɨr gu oidha' bɨx guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.
Jano' ba' jix duu jix bɨɨx duu gu Jawatan Dios gu tanoolh kɨɨv tu duukam jix utu'ñ gu tanoolh kɨɨv bɨx tu duukam ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.
Ba' jix aa' jix bhai' aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu tanoolh kɨɨv jix bhaan duu na gu' jix utu'ñ bɨx tu duukam ka't gu Jawatan Dios jix duu guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.
Jano' ba' jix duu dhi' ja'tkam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu tɨkɨr gu oidha' na pai' dhuuk jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios gu oidha' gu tɨkɨr.

Jano' ba' bɨx gu vaas yooxi' va'k jum duu gu oidha' bɨx gu vaas yooxi' va'k guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; na gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ cham ka't gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bhaan gu oidha' tu' ka't gu chio'ñ na ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam pai'.
Gu' gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu oidha' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bɨx gu vupui gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Jawatan Dios gu chio'ñ oo' gu oidha' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam daak guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu oidha'; gio ba' ka't gu chio'ñ gu i'ii'ñ na jix do'ig.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ u'uu pai' gu Edeen tas buusñi jix dhaas gu chio'ñ ka't guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' ka't gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam maaxilhia' gu oidha' bɨx gu u'u guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ñiata jix bhai' na ba' jugi; gio ba' gio gu u'u gu oidha' tɨjɨɨ'ñ u'uu pai' gu u'u guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam xoi'kam cham bhai'.
Jano' ba' busaak gu Edeen gɨ' suudai' jiim na ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam u'uu pai' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn maakobh guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga.
Jano' ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' maa'n ka't gu Pisoon; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam mia'n bɨx gu oidha' gu abila pai' cham tu'x jai'ch jix uam jodai.
Jano' ba' jix uam jodai mii' dhɨr gu oidha' jix bhai'; gio ba' cham tu'x jai'ch gio guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu jodai guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.
Jano' ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gook gɨ' suudai' jiim gu Gioon; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bɨx gu oidha' gu Etiopiia.
Jano' ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' vaik gɨ' suudai' jiim gu iddekel; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu' vupui bhaan gu Asiria; mi' dhɨr maakobh gɨ' suudai' jiim gu Euprates.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Jawatan Dios gu chio'ñ jix dhaas u'uu pai' gu Edeen na ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn jix nukadham.
Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix gu Jawatan Dios gu chio'ñ bham; gio ba' bɨx gu u'u u'uu pai' jugi.
Gu' gu' gu u'u guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam xoi'kam cham bhai' cham jugi; na gu' gu tanoolh jix duu koi.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham jix bhai' gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ u'ua'tɨdham guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat na ba'.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu Jawatan Dios gu oidha' bɨx gu vaakax yooxi' bɨx gu u'uvhig gu tɨkɨr guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Adam na ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu ñi'ook ka't guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga; gio ba' bɨx gu Adam jup tɨɨt gu vaakax na jix do'ig guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu tɨɨgɨ'.

Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu Adam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bɨx gu vaakax gu u'uvhig gu tɨkɨr bɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm yooxi'; gu' na ba' gu Adam cham gu ñi'ook u'ua'tɨdham guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat na ba'.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bhaan gu Adam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn; gio ba' jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu chuukug pai'.
Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Jawatan Dios jix bhɨɨ gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu chio'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' gu Adam; gio ba' dhi' jano' o'o o'oo gu chuukug; na gu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ ka't mɨmɨim gu Barona na gu' gu chio'ñ ka't guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.
Na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam kiicha' gu chio'ñ gu taat gu naan tu jiim tu' gu u'vɨ ka't guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' mi'p guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ dha'npak gu Adam gu u'vɨ cham guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.

Gu' gu' gu ko'oi ka't guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bɨx gu vaakax yooxi' gu Jawatan Dios ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; gio ba' jix aa' gu u'vɨ; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bɨx gu u'u u'uu pai'.
Jano' ba' gu u'vɨ jix aa' gu ko'oi; gio ba' gu i'bhɨ gu u'u u'uu pai' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.
Ba' jix aa' gu' gu i'bhɨ gu u'u tɨjɨɨ'ñ u'uu pai' gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' cham jugi tu' kuichdha' na gu' cham vaak jodai.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu ko'oi gu u'vɨ; gio ba' cham koi.
Gu' gu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan Dios gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu vupui boopoya' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios pu'ñir xoi'kam cham bhai'.

Jano' ba' jix ñi' gu u'vɨ gu u'u ka't jix bhai' na ba' jugi ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu vupui gu u'u guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ na ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn matda'; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu i'bhɨ jix jugi; mi' dhɨr jix maa gio gu chio'ñ jix jugi na ja'p.

Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu vupui ba'k guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn mi'p dha'npak; gio ba' jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim iigɨx jix duu guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios u'uu pai' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu tanoolh; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jawatan Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu u'u u'uu pai'.
Ba' jix aa' jup tɨɨt gu Jawatan Dios gu chio'ñ; gio ba' duukat guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu'.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; na gu' tu' gu ñi'ook u'uu pai' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios ɨɨbhi'ñ na gu' ka't tɨbiaptuda; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' chɨkka tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat dhi' tɨbiaptuda guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu u'u tu' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga cham guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ jix aa'; gio ba' gu u'vɨ chɨɨdak guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ jix maa gu u'u tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu u'vɨ; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam jix aa' gu u'vɨ; mi' dhɨr gu ko'oi guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu ko'oi; na gu' dhi' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa ka' tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu vaakax tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu vaakax yooxi'; mi' dhɨr bhaan baaso guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ oo' jugi bɨx gu tanoolh gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu u'vɨ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kai' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tu' jix duu mo'o tu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.

Ba' jix aa' gu u'vɨ; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu ma'nkam; jano' ba' gu chio'ñ ka't gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tu'.

Ba' jix aa' gu chio'ñ; na gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu ñi'ook gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu u'u tu' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bham cham jugi; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa ka't gu oidha' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm xoi'kam tu'; jano' ba' bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jugi bɨx gu tanoolh gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jugi gu vaas yooxi'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu vupui jugi gu takarui' bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu oidha'; na gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; na gu' oo' jix duu oo' ka' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.
Jano' ba' jup tɨɨt gu chio'ñ gu tɨɨgɨ' gu u'vɨ gu Eeba; na gu' ka't gu naan bɨx na jix do'ig.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Jawatan Dios gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ kutun na jix toja tɨɨt guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu u'u gu Goper; gio ba' jix duu guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu jiim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mai'.

Jano' ba' dhi' jix duu; gio ba' vaik guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tu jiim.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam jix duu kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook novɨ maa'nkar guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm baasɨ'n jiix; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim ki'ñgob kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim; mi' dhɨr jix duu guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gook vaik.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu suudai' bhaan gu oidha' na ba' cham tu' duu bɨx gu chuukug ka't gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu oidha' bɨtaa'n gu tɨkɨr; gio ba' bɨx cham tu'x jai'ch pai' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.
Gu' gu' dhi' ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨndak ba'k kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' tu' gu ma'nkam gu u'vɨ gu ma'nkam bɨndak.

Jano' ba' bɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bɨx gu chuukug gook na jax chu'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' na ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu oidha' bɨndak; gio ba' gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ ka't.
Jano' ba' gu u'uvhig bhaan na jax chu'm gu vaakax bhaan na jax chu'm bɨx gu ko'oi gu oidha' bhaan na jax chu'm gook na jax chu'm jɨjɨkgɨm bɨndak na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bɨndak bɨx guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tu'; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jugi na ba' tu' na ba'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Noee; gio ba' jix duu jurtu'nka' bɨx gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Noee; gio ba' ba'k tu' bɨx gu vaak kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora'; na gu' tu' buupui jir bhai' vupui bhaan tu' dhi' jix duu.
Jano' ba' bɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm na jix bhai' tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn kɨɨv gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ; gu' gu vaakax cham guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gook gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' gio gu u'uvhig gu tɨkɨr kɨɨv gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ; na ba' nukadham gu oidha' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhaan gu vupui bɨx gu oidha'.

Na gu' na gu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn kɨɨv gu tanoolh tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bhaan gu oidha' oo'm gu tanoolh oo'm gu tukaa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bhaan gu vupui gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Noee jurtu'nka' bɨx jix aa'ñdhix gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Noee guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu suudai' ka't bhaan gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu Noee gu ma'nkam gu u'vɨ gu ma'nkam bɨɨx kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu suudai' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' gu vaakax guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu vaakax cham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu u'uvhig bɨx guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bhaan gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gook baap gu Noee kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ na ja'p jix aa'ñdhix gu Jawatan Dios gu Noee.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kɨɨv gu tanoolh gu suudai' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix bɨɨx duu bhaan gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' oidha' tas guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu oidha' gu Noee guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gook guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ suudai' buusñi jix gɨ' jix dhaam suudai' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu tɨkɨr jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.
Jano' ba' ka't dhuuk bhaan gu oidha' oo'm gu tanoolh oo'm gu tukaa'.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu tanoolh chɨbiapui gu Noee gu Sem gu Kâm gu Japet gu ma'nkam gu Noee gu u'vɨ gu Noee vaik gu u'vɨ gu ma'nkam bɨɨx kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' bɨx gu vaakax guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bhaan guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bɨx gu vaakax guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bhaan guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bɨx gu ko'oi guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bhaan gu oidha' bhaan na jax chu'm bɨx gu u'uvhig bhaan na jax chu'm bɨx guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bɨx na jax chu'm da'a.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu Noee kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gook bɨx gu chuukug ka't gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ bɨx gu chuukug tɨɨtɨs na ja'p ka't jix duu gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ ki'ñgob.

Jano' ba' ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ oo'm gu tanoolh bhaan gu oidha'; gio ba' gu suudai' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bhaan gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu suudai' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bhaan gu oidha'; gio ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' bhaan gu vupui gu suudai'.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jix jai' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bhaan gu oidha'; gio ba' bɨx gu kakkavɨk guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios ka't bɨtaa'n bɨx gu tɨkɨr jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu suudai'; gio ba' jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu kakkavɨk.

Jano' ba' jix koi bɨx gu chuukug oidha' bhaan jiim bhaan gu oidha' gu u'uvhig na ja'p guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu vaakax bɨx gu ko'oi guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bhaan pai' bɨx gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' bɨx ga'ra' gu i'ii'ñ gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu oidha' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bɨx ka't gu oidha' jix koi.

Jano' ba' ka't guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bhaan gu vupui gu oidha' dɨr gu chio'ñ bɨɨx ka'm gu vaakax gu ko'oi gu u'uvhig gu tɨkɨr; gio ba' jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Noee bɨɨx ka't kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu suudai' bhaan gu oidha' chamaam mambhɨɨx gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' tɨ'ñcho gu Jawatan Dios gu Noee bɨx gu vaakax guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu vaakax mi'p bɨɨx kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora'; gio ba' tu' jix duu guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Jawatan Dios gu jɨvɨl bhaan gu oidha' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ suudai' buusñi jix dhaam suudai' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu tɨkɨr; gio ba' dhuuk gu tɨkɨr ka't guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu suudai' bhaan gu oidha' jiimchu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu suudai' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam chamaam mambhɨɨx gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' jix utu'ñ kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ kɨɨv guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bhaan gu kakkavɨk gu Armenia.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga maa'n guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu kakkavɨk.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam oo'm gu tanoolh jix kupi'ook gu Noee guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.
Jano' ba' bhañ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jix buus juruuñ jiimchu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bɨɨx ka'm gu suudai' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bhaan gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' bhañ gio gioda' na ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu' gu suudai' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bhaan gu vupui gu oidha'.

Na gu' cham gu ñi'ook gioda' pai' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu vaas tɨɨt guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' na gu' gu suudai' mi'p guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bhaan gu vupui bɨx gu oidha'; gio ba' jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu novɨ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios jix duu baakɨi baidhak kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn kɨɨv gu tanoolh guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tɨip gioda' mai' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' gioda' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu tas gu xumai; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jajar guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Noee gu suudai' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bhaan gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn kɨɨv gu tanoolh bhañ gioda' cham guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm oidha' tas guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm maa'n gu Noee guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ maa'n guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu suudai' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bhaan gu oidha'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Noee iiñat kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' tu jiim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu vupui pai' ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gook guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu oidha'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Noee bham.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' tu' gu u'vɨ gu ma'nkam gu u'vɨ gu ma'nkam bɨndak.

Jano' ba' bɨx gu vaakax bɨndak bɨx gu chuukug gu u'uvhig gu vaakax bɨx gu ko'oi guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bhaan gu oidha' jix buusñi bɨndak; gio ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu oidha' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bhaan pai'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix buus gu Noee gu ma'nkam gu u'vɨ gu ma'nkam bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu vaakax bɨx gu ko'oi bɨx gu u'uvhig bɨx oidha' bhaan jiim bhaan gu oidha' bhaan guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ moor kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Noee jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios jix bhɨɨ bɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm na jix bhai' bɨx gu u'uvhig makgɨrxi maa'nkar tai bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Jawatan Dios tu jiim guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios; gio ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu i'ii'ñ; mi' dhɨr cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu oidha' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kuiñcha gu chio'ñ; na gu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu i'ii'ñ gu chio'ñ cham bhai' dɨr guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ cham tu' duu bɨx na jix do'ig na ja'p guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ ka't bɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu oidha'; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa oraa' jix jɨɨpi' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu tanoolh gu tukaa' cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.
Ba' jix aa' jix bhai' aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Noee gu ma'nkam; gio ba' jix maa gu i'bhɨ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jix bhuup gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' choo'n guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn ka't bhaan bɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu oidha' bhaan bɨx gu u'uvhig gu tɨkɨr bɨx guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu oidha' bɨx gu vatop gu gɨ' suudai'; gio ba' gu novɨ kapbhai'.
Jano' ba' bɨx oidha' bhaan jiim guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam ka't na ba' jugi; gio ba' na ja'p guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ jix maa bɨx.
Gu' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu chuukug bɨɨx gu oidha' gu ɨ'ɨr cham jugi.

Na gu' na gu' gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu ɨ'ɨr guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; gio ba' gu novɨ bɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu novɨ gu chio'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu novɨ gu chio'ñ xibhɨk guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu oidha' gu chio'ñ.

Na guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu ɨ'ɨr gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu chio'ñ gu ɨ'ɨr ka't guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; na gu' na jax chu'm gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu chio'ñ.
Gu' gu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jix maa gu i'bhɨ jix mui' jum duu; gio ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu oidha' jix mui' jum duu.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Noee gu ma'nkam bɨɨx bham.
Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' dhi' ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨɨx gu kai' mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.

Jano' ba' bɨɨx bɨx gu i'ii'ñ na jix do'ig bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu u'uvhig gu vaakax bɨx gu vaakax gu oidha' bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; gio ba' dɨr bɨx moor kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' bɨɨx ka'm bɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' dhi' ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat cham guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bɨx gu chuukug bɨɨx gu suudai' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ na ba' cham tu' duu gu oidha'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' dhi' ka't nɨi'ñchudat ñi'ook na jix bhaan tu' dhi' tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨx gu i'ii'ñ na jix do'ig bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.
Jano' ba' u'u gat guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tɨbaa'ñ ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm nɨi'ñchudat guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu oidha'.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tɨbaa'ñ bhaan gu oidha' kiicha' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jano' ba' u'u gat tɨbaa'ñ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn ñi'ook na jix bhaan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam cham tu'x jai'ch tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨx gu i'ii'ñ na jix do'ig bɨx gu chuukug; gio ba' cham ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu suudai' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ na ba' cham tu' duu bɨx gu chuukug.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam u'u gat tɨbaa'ñ jix ñi' na ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn ñi'ook na jix bhaan guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu i'ii'ñ na jix do'ig bɨɨx bɨx gu chuukug cham tu'x jai'ch bhaan gu oidha'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Noee; gio ba' dhi' ka't nɨi'ñchudat ñi'ook na jix bhaan dhi' tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' bɨx gu chuukug bhaan gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Noee moor kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' jix bɨɨx duu gu Sem gu Kâm gu Japet; gio ba' gu Kâm gu taat gu Kanaan.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam vaik gu ma'nkam gu Noee; gio ba' ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bɨx gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' kua'da' gu Noee guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu oidha' jix dhaas oidha' u'va.
Jano' ba' jix i'i suudai' u'va guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ ka't guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaak zel.
Ba' jix aa' gu Kâm gu taat gu Kanaan jix ñi' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu taat gook gu ja'tkam baasɨ'n guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Sem gu Japet guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix dhaas bhaan guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bhaan guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu taat ua'tulhdhidha' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam cham guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu taat.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Noee suudai' u'va guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bɨɨx gu mar guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa ka't gu Kanaan; mi' dhɨr tu duukam ka't gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu Japet guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn vaak zel gu Sem guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Kanaan tu duukam.
Jano' ba' jix oidha' gu Noee mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ vaik mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' ka't ba'bhak dɨr gu Mesa bai'ñpu' gu Separ gu kavɨk baasɨ'n tas buusñi.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Sem guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ñiiñio'k guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' jix koi jix duu va'k gu taat gu Tare gu oidha' na jax chu'm gu Ur gu Kaldeos.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Abraam gu Nakôr na ba' gu u'vɨ; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu u'vɨ gu Abraam ka't gu Saara gu tɨɨgɨ' gu u'vɨ gu Nakôr gu Milka mar u'vɨ jix duu gu taat gu Milka gu Iska.
Gu' gu' gu Saara ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ cham ga'ra' gu mar.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Tare gu Abraam gu mar gu Lot gu mar jix duu gu mar gu Saara guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu u'vɨ gu Abraam gu mar; gio ba' jix buus bɨɨx gu Ur gu Kaldeos na ba' tu' gu oidha' gu Kanaan; mi' dhɨr tɨɨtɨs bɨɨx ka'm jix duu guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu tanoolh gu Tare guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios jixchamaam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; gio ba' jix koi gu Tare jix duu.
Gu' gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook gu Abraam; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu oidha' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu vaak gu taat gu oidha' tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu' gu ja'tkam jix gɨ' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu tɨɨgɨ' ka' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' jix bhai' aa' tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; gio ba' ka't guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu oidha'.

Ba' jix aa' ka't gu Abraam na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' ka't bɨɨx gu Lot; na pai' dhuuk ka't gu Abraam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jixchamaam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ na pai' dhuuk jix buus jix duu.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Abraam gu Saara gu u'vɨ gu Lot gu mar xibhɨk bɨx guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu vaakax gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jix duu moor na ba' tu' gu oidha' gu Kanaan; gio ba' gu oidha' gu Kanaan guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Abraam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mii' dhɨr gu oidha' bɨɨx ka'm pai' gu Sikêm bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu More; gio ba' gu Kananeo ka't jano' ba' gu oidha'.
Ba' jix aa' jix ñi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Abraam; gio ba' gu kai' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ dhi' gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr pai'x jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios ka't guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu kavɨk tas buusñi gu Betel guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ vaak zel ua'tulhdhidha' gu Betel tas gei'ñ gu ai tas buusñi; gio ba' pai'x jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Abraam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ jiimchu' bhaan gu Mediodiia.
Jano' ba' ka't bhiogi' gu oidha' jix dhaav gu Abraam gu Ejipto na ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam; na gu' ka't jix gɨ' bhiogi' gu oidha'.
Ba' jix aa' ka't na pai' dhuuk ka't na ba' baakɨi gu Ejipto gu Saara gu u'vɨ; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jano' kakasnira' jix duu gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn ñiata.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ buupui gu Egipkios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; gio ba' gu u'vɨ; mi' dhɨr yaa' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' jano' tu' jix duu gu ja'tkam na ba' tu' ka't xoi'kam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kuiñcha guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm xoi'kam tu'.
Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p chɨbiapui gu Abraam gu Ejipto gu Egipkios guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu u'vɨ ka't guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gio chiñia' gu Faraoon guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; gio ba' ka't guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu u'vɨ gu vaak gu Faraoon.

Jano' ba' jix duu xoi'kam gu Abraam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kuiñcha; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim kakneer guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam buur tu duukam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ buur jix ai.
Gu' gu' gu Jawatan Dios naaka'n gu Faraoon gu vaak bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kuiñcha gu Saara gu u'vɨ gu Abraam.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Faraoon jup tɨɨt gu Abraam; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim dhi' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Por guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim cham guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ ka't gu u'vɨ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bua' jix bhɨɨ na ba' tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu u'vɨ jano' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Faraoon jix maa guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam chɨbɨɨp guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Abraam; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu u'vɨ bɨɨx bɨx ga'ra'.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Abraam gu Ejipto bhaan gu Mediodiia gu u'vɨ bɨɨx bɨx ga'ra' bɨɨx gu Lot.
Jano' ba' gu Abraam ka't guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu vaakax jix toja jodai jix uam jodai.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ baasɨ'n gu Mediodiia bhaan gu Betel bɨɨx ka'm pai' ka't dhi' va'k vaak zel tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Betel gu ai.
Jano' ba' pai' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam va'k; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Abraam gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Lot guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bɨɨx gu Abraam ga'ra' kakneer guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam vaak zel.

Jano' ba' gu oidha' cham guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga jix duu na ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tɨtda:―Aañ; na gu' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga ka't guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn cham guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam pai'.
Jano' ba' ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tɨjɨɨ'ñ bipia'dam gu vaakax gu Abraam bipia'dam gu vaakax gu Lot; gio ba' gu Kananeo gu Pereseo oi'ñka' jano' ba' gu oidha'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Abraam gu Lot; na gu' cham ka't jano' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ bipia'dam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga na gu' gu'ch gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' cham bɨx gu oidha' vupui bhaan tu' soi'ñ tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa tu'; gio ba' tu' tu jiim gu novɨ o'nsop tu' jix duu; mi' dhɨr tu' jix duu tu' o'nsop.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Lot gu vupui jix ñi' bɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Jordaan bɨx ka't guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim va'k guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jawatan Dios gu Sodoma gu Gomorra na ja'p u'uu pai' gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p gu oidha' gu Ejipto baakɨk gu Soar.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Lot guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ na ba' bɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Jordaan; gio ba' ta'tak gu Lot tas buusñi guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa maa'n.

Jano' ba' gu Abraam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu oidha' gu Kanaan gu Lot guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios jɨ'dɨlh guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ ka't guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ vaak zel bɨɨx ka'm gu Sodoma.
Gu' gu' gu chichio'ñ gu Sodoma guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tomaat u'ua'tulhdhix na ba' bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Abraam mi' dhɨr gu Lot jix ai'chdhix; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jano' gu vupui guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam dɨr pai' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bhaan gu Akuiloon gu Mediodiia tas buusñi tas gei'ñ.
Na gu' na gu' bɨx gu oidha' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tu' gu kai' na ba' bɨɨx tas.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu kai' na ja'p oo' gu oidha'; na tu' oi'ñdha' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam oo' gu oidha' gio gu kai' ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.
Jano' ba' bamii' tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu oidha' tu jiim guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga; na gu' tu' no'ñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Abraam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios vaak zel suudai' u'va guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Mamre gu ebroon jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tanoolh gu Amrapel gu gɨ'kora' gu Sinar gu Ariok gu gɨ'kora' gu Elasar gu Kêdorlaomer gu gɨ'kora' gu Elaa gu Tidal gu gɨ'kora' gu ja'tkam.

Na suulhgia' jix duu bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan gu Bera gu gɨ'kora' gu Sodoma bhaan gu Birsa gu gɨ'kora' gu Gomorra bhaan gu Sinab gu gɨ'kora' gu Adma bhaan gu Semeber gu gɨ'kora' gu Seboim bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu Bela gu Soar.
Jano' ba' bɨx dhi' ja'tkam jum daa'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Siddim gu gɨ' suudai' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Kêdorlaomer guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam oidha' tas guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' oidha' tas guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga suudai' u'va gu Kêdorlaomer gu gɨ'kora' mi'p baasɨ'n guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Rapaitas gu Asterot-karnaim gu Susitas gu am gu Emitas gu Sabe-kiriataim.
Jano' ba' gu oreos gu kavɨk gu Seir bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Paraan ju'ñdharan oidha' jix gaki.
Jano' ba' suulh tɨɨtɨs gu Emmispat gu Kades guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Amalekitas gio gu Amorreo guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu asesoon-tamar.

Jano' ba' jix buus gu gɨ'kora' gu Sodoma gu gɨ'kora' gu Gomorra gu gɨ'kora' gu Adma gu gɨ'kora' gu Seboim gu gɨ'kora' gu Bela gu Soar guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bhaan guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Siddim.

Jano' ba' maachim bhaan gu Kêdorlaomer gu gɨ'kora' gu Elam gu Tidal gu gɨ'kora' gu ja'tkam gu Amrapel gu gɨ'kora' gu Sinar gu Ariok gu gɨ'kora' gu Elasar; gio ba' maakobh gu gɨ'kora' bhaan jixchamaam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Siddim ka't jix bhuup oidha' suudai' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam; gio ba' jiboi'ññor gu gɨ'kora' gu Sodoma gu Gomorra ia'rɨ; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam jiboi'ññor gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨx guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Sodoma gu Gomorra guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jix bɨɨx duu.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gio gu Lot gu mar xibhɨk gu Abraam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Sodoma guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga jix bɨɨx duu.

Jano' ba' suudai' u'va maa'n guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Abraam gu ebreo guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Mamre gu Amorreo xibhɨk gu Eskôl xibhɨk gu Aner mi'p guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨɨx gu Abraam.
Jano' ba' jix kai gu Abraam xibhɨk ka't guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu vaak vaik guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios chɨ'ɨɨk bɨɨx ka'm gu Dan.
Jano' ba' ja'aa bhaan gu tukaa' tu duukam tu' naaka'n ka't guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bɨɨx ka'm gu oba o'nsop gu Damasko.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bɨx xoi'kam gio gu Lot xibhɨk guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gio gu u'vɨ gu ja'tkam.

Na pai' dhuuk jix buus gu gɨ'kora' gu Sodoma jix duu na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Kêdorlaomer gu gɨ'kora' bɨɨx mi'p guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Sabe guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Melkîsedek gu gɨ'kora' gu Salem jix buusñi gu takarui' suudai' u'va; gio ba' ka't jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.
Ba' jix aa' jix bhai' aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ ka't gu Abraam gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bia'ka' gu tɨkɨr gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ ka't gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ do'ñcho guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu novɨ; gio ba' jix maa gu Abraam boosgi bɨx.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Sodoma gu Abraam; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam na ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga.
Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Abraam gu gɨ'kora' gu Sodoma; gio ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bia'ka' gu tɨkɨr gu oidha'.

Na gu' dɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam cham tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ na gu' cham guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Abraam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam koi'mɨk biipibop guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu chio'ñ jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Aner gu Eskôl gu Mamre; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam baasɨ'n.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' tu'x ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Abraam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bham; gio ba' cham jum i'obh gu Abraam; mi' dhɨr tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim kutun kavɨk guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim daam jix gɨ'.

Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Abraam; gio ba' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam cham gu mar guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu vaak guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Damaskeno gu Elieser.

Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu ñiokda' bɨɨx jix tɨ'ɨ gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu Abraam.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Abraam gu Ismael gu mar bɨx tu duukam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu vaak bɨx jiimɨt guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tuumiñ bɨx gu chio'ñ tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu vaak gu Abraam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu chuukug tu jiim mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't gu Abraam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu chuukug tu jiim.
Na pai' dhuuk gu Ismael gu mar ka't guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ na pai' dhuuk ka't guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu chuukug tu jiim.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh ka't guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Abraam tu' gu Ismael gu mar.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu chio'ñ gu vaak tu duukam maaxir gu vaak guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tuumiñ ja'tkam mii' dhɨr jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu Aparekioole gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Mamre kua' daakat ki'ñgob vaak zel guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu vupui tu jiim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm vaik gu chio'ñ mi'p ju'ñdharan; na pai' dhuuk jix ñi' jix buus guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ ki'ñgob vaak zel jix duu tu' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bhaan gu oidha'.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu Jawatan tu' jano' gaagam nɨidhidha' gu vupui guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn cham guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ tu duukam.
Na guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jano' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu suudai' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tɨɨt; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bɨtaa'n gu u'u.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu chin gu takarui' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; na gu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ mia'n tu duukam; jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' gu vupui na ja'p tu ñi'ook.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Abraam ka't guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ vaak zel gu Saara; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jootom vaik guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu vupui gu takarui' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bɨtaa'n guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.

Jano' ba' dai'bus gu Abraam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam jix bhɨɨ tuur guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jix bhai' jix maa guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jix maa guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tu jiim.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gio guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bii'm tuur ka't guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios jix dhaas vupui bhaan; gio ba' ka't ju'ñdharan bɨtaa'n gu u'u; mi' dhɨr koi'mɨk.
Jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' duukat gu Saara gu u'vɨ jix aa'; mi' dhɨr vaak zel.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba'; gio ba' tɨɨda' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tu' bhaan guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu oidha' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu mar gu Saara gu u'vɨ; mi' dhɨr gu Saara guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios ki'ñgob vaak zel ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu Abraam gu Saara guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm nu'aa' ba'k gu tanoolh; gio ba' gu Saara ka't guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu u'vɨ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Saara tɨjɨɨ'ñ bham; gio ba' mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gio gu Jawatan tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Abraam; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Saara bham; mi' dhɨr ka't tɨɨda' tu jiim guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.

Jano' ba' cham tu'x jai'ch na ba' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios nɨi'ñchudat guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tu' bhaan guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu oidha' gu Saara guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu mar.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Saara guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bham; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; na gu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim ɨɨbhi'ñ; jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ jix búup tu jiim bhaan gu Sodoma; gio ba' gu Abraam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bɨɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu' gu Abraam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' dhaibu guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Abraam gu ja'tkam jix gɨ' jix kavɨk dhaibu guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ chɨbɨɨp gu oidha'.

Na gu' na gu' tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu ma'nkam gu vaak mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bɨx bhai' ñi'ook na jir bhai' na ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu Abraam tu' tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' tu ñi'ook gu Sodoma gu Gomorra guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ uañi'ñ tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jano' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tu duukam bhaan tu ñi'ook tu' tɨbiap bɨɨx ka'm tu'; gio ba' tu' cham maachim.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu chio'ñ jix bɨɨx duu bhaan gu Sodoma; gu' gu Abraam ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Abraam; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gio jir bhai' bɨɨx cham bhai' ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn cham tu'x jai'ch mambhɨɨx jir bhai' ja'tkam tu jiim kiicham; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gio cham uañi'ñka' pai' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mambhɨɨx jir bhai' ja'tkam tu jiim.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu jiim guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa koi jir bhai' bɨɨx cham bhai' ja'tkam ka't jir bhai' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm na ja'p cham bhai' ja'tkam; gio ba' cham pai' dhuuk tu jiim guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa; mi' dhɨr jir bɨx bhai' bɨx gu oidha' cham tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jir bhai'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' bakia' gu Sodoma mambhɨɨx jir bhai' ja'tkam tu jiim kiicham guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bɨx dhi' pai' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm xoi'kam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Abraam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jano' kua'da' ñiokda' gu Jawatan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim oo' maatai.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ mambhɨɨx jir bhai' ja'tkam jixchamaam; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mii' dhɨr ja'tkam jixchamaam bɨx kiicham jix aa'; mi' dhɨr cham guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga tu' bakia' oo'm jixchamaam.

Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ ñiokda'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu ñi'ook oo'm; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm xoi'kam oo'm.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jano' gu Jawatan tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ; jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu' bakia' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jano' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim ñiokda' gu Jawatan; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ; jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga jix aa' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm xoi'kam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jano' gu Jawatan tu' tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu jiim; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx; jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga jix aa' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm xoi'kam mambhɨɨx.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Jawatan Dios jix bɨɨx duu ñiokda' gu Abraam; gio ba' gu Abraam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ pai'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gook daada' gu Sodoma guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu xumai; gio ba' gu Lot ka't daakat ki'ñgob gu Sodoma; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Lot jix búup jix duu tu' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bhaan guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' jano' gu Jawatan soi'ñ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu vaak tu duukam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tɨɨt; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu xibh guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu bhóogɨt; jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham ɨrban guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ dhi' gu tukaa'.
Gu' gu' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bɨɨx jix jai' tɨɨtɨs bɨɨx baap gu vaak; gio ba' tu' jix duu guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu takarui' cham jabka' koi'mɨk.

Jano' ba' va'k guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu vaak gu chichio'ñ kiicham gu chio'ñ gu Sodoma bɨx gu ja'tkam ju'ñdharan dɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Lot gui'p; gio ba' duukat gu chio'ñ tɨɨtɨs tu' dhi' gu tukaa' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios na ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Lot jix buus ki'ñgob guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ kiki'ñgob bhaan.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' soi'ñ gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ cham guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tu jiim tu' na cham jir bhai'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jano' tu' no'ñ gook ma'nkam u'uuvɨ cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu chio'ñ; gio ba' jix buusñi guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn na ja'p xoi'kam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam dhi' ja'tkam gu chio'ñ cham guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios cham tu' tɨɨtɨs ɨkgiga'n guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa; jano' ba' suudai' u'va guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam na ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ na ja'p guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios tu jiim jir bɨx bhai' jano' tu' chulhiiñchuda' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ cham bhai'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu chio'ñ gu Lot guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ na ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn kiki'ñgob.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu novɨ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Lot gu vaak bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ kiki'ñgob.
Jano' ba' gu chichio'ñ mi'p ki'ñgob gu vaak dɨr jix ali' bɨɨx ka'm jix gɨ' jix duu bɨɨx guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn; gu' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob.

Jano' ba' gui'p gu chio'ñ gu Lot; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa oi'ñdha' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Yernos gu ma'nkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ bɨx guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa kiicham guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat dhi' pai'.

Na gu' na gu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ cham tu' duu dhi' pai' na gu' tu ñi'ook tu' tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ na ba' cham tu' duu.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' jix buus gu Lot guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ dhi' pai'; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' cham tu' duu dhi' kiicham; gu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn na ja'p guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam daada' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Lot bham; na gu' bamii' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu u'vɨ gook ma'nkam u'uuvɨ bakia' na gu' cham guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ sɨlhka'n kiicham.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu novɨ gu u'vɨ gu noobh gook ma'nkam u'uuvɨ bhaan xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu Jawatan Dios na ba' bɨɨx; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jix dhaas mai' kiicham.

Ba' jix aa' ka't na pai' dhuuk ka't jix buusñi mai'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr cham tu jiim bhaan tu' tu jiim bɨx dhi' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu kavɨk cham ka't guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.
Ba' jix aa' gu Lot; gio ba' cham tu' soi'ñ gu Jawatan guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jano' tu' gaagam tu duukam nɨidhidha' gu vupui guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu oidha'; gu' tu' cham guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu kavɨk cham ka't guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm cham bhai' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jano' dhi' kiicham mia'n na ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jano' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ ii'mdagaram gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm dho'ñchidhak gio ñi'ook Jawatan bhaan dhi' cham guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga kiicham tu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; na gu' cham tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bɨɨx ka'm cham tu'x jai'ch tu jiim; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm dhi' ka't tɨɨgim gu tɨɨgɨ' kiicham gu Soar.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tas busaak bhaan gu oidha' na pai' dhuuk gu Lot guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Soar.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu Sodoma bhaan gu Gomorra choiñ gu tai baasɨ'n gu Jawatan Dios dɨr gu tɨkɨr.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ jɨ'dɨlh bɨx mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bɨɨx bɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mii' dhɨr jɨ'dɨlh gu i'bhɨ gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu u'vɨ gu Lot tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ dhi' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Abraam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu xibh pai' ka't dhi' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' tu jiim bhaan gu Sodoma gu Gomorra bhaan bɨx gu oidha' mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tu jiim; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kuubh guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu oidha' na ja'p kuubh guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga.

Na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Jawatan Dios jɨ'dɨlh guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tɨ'ñcho gu Jawatan Dios gu Abraam bhañ mai' gu Lot tɨjɨɨ'ñ chajaañ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jɨ'dɨlh pai' gu Lot ka't.

Gu' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Lot jix tɨ'ɨ gu Soar guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu kavɨk gook ma'nkam u'uuvɨ bɨɨx; na gu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim ɨɨbhi'ñ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Soar guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ jumpa'n gook ma'nkam u'uuvɨ.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' jix gɨ' jix ali'; gio ba' chulhiiñdha' gu taat guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu chio'ñ gu oidha' tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bɨx gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ i'i suudai' u'va chulhiiñdha' gu taat guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ chulhiiñdha' gu taat jix duu.

Jano' ba' jix maa i'i suudai' u'va gu taat mii' dhɨr gu tukaa'; gio ba' chɨbiapui jix gɨ' jix koox bɨɨx gu taat; gu' cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn duuk guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu' duuk jix búup.

Ba' jix aa' gu tanoolh buimgidhak jix gɨ' jix ali'; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu tukaa' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bɨɨx gu taat; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ i'i suudai' u'va gio dhi' gu tukaa' ba'k guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bɨɨx na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ chulhiiñdha' gu taat jix duu.

Jano' ba' jix maa i'i suudai' u'va gu taat gio mii' dhɨr gu tukaa'; gio ba' jix búup jix ali' jix koox bɨɨx; gu' cham guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn duuk guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu' duuk jix búup.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gook ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Lot gu taat.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam jix gɨ' gu mar jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Moab gu taat gu Moabitas bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.
Jano' ba' jix ali' gio guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu mar jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Ben-ammii gu taat gu Ammonitas bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.
Jano' ba' ta'tak gu Abraam gu oidha' gu Mediodiia guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Kades gu Sur guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ na ja'p ja'tkam mii' dhɨr gu Gerar.
Ba' jix aa' gu Abraam gu Saara gu u'vɨ; gio ba' gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gu Abimelek gu gɨ'kora' gu Gerar bhañ jix bhɨɨ gu Saara.

Ba' jix aa' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios suudai' u'va gu Abimelek tɨɨtki' gu tukaa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jix koi jix duu kuiñcha gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bɨɨx gu chio'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' gu' gu Abimelek cham ka't tu jiim; gio ba' gu Jawatan koo'nda' gio gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Ba' jix aa' cham; gio ba' gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gio jix aa'; jano' ba' xibhɨk bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu i'ii'ñ bɨɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu noobh guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam dhi'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios tɨɨtki'; gio ba' tu' gio tu' bɨɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam dhi'; mi' dhɨr tu' gio tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bhaan tu' cham tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.

Jano' ba' jano' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu u'vɨ gu chio'ñ; na gu' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' ii'mdagaram; mi' dhɨr tu' cham jix duu guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tɨɨda' koi bɨɨx bɨx ua'tulhi'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Abimelek jix búup gu xibh jup tɨɨt bɨx tu duukam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ dhi' gu ñi'ook maatɨt; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu chichio'ñ.

Ba' jix aa' mi' dhɨr jup tɨɨt gu Abimelek gu Abraam; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tu' bhaan tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bhaan tu' bhaan oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios uañi'ñ cham guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.
Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Abimelek gu Abraam; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ dhi'.
Jano' ba' gu Abraam jix aa'; na gu' tu ñi'ook na ba' tu'; mi' dhɨr tɨɨda' cham cham tu'x jai'ch choo'n gu Jawatan Dios dhi' pai' yaa' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kuiñcha gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' tu'r gio gu ja'tkam mar u'vɨ gu taat gu' cham mar u'vɨ gu naan guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu u'vɨ.

Jano' ba' jix duu ka't na pai' dhuuk gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu vaak gu taat tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' dhi' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tu' jix duu bɨx pai' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tu'; mi' dhɨr xibhɨk.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Abimelek jix bhɨɨ kakneer guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tu duukam ja'tkam na tu juan jix maa gu Abraam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Saara gu u'vɨ.
Ba' jix aa' gu Abimelek; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu oidha' vupui bhaan tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ pai' xoi'kam tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Ba' jix aa' gu Saara; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jix maa mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ jix toja jodai xibhɨk; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu jiim gu vupui na ba' bɨx bɨndak na ba' bɨɨx bɨx; jano' ba' ka't guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Abraam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Abimelek gu u'vɨ ja'tkam na tu juan tu jiim.
Na gu' na gu' ka't bɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Jawatan Dios bɨx guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu vaak gu Abimelek kuiñcha gu Saara gu u'vɨ gu Abraam.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Bisitoo gu Jawatan Dios gu Saara na ja'p ka't tu ñi'ook tu' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu Saara na ja'p ka't.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Saara gu Abraam gu mar guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jup tɨɨt gu Abraam gu tɨɨgɨ' gu mar guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Saara gu Isaak.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Abraam gu mar gu Isaak guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu tanoolh na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duu.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't gu Abraam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Isaak gu mar.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Saara; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ no'x guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; gio ba' chɨkka tu ñi'ook gu Abraam gu Saara ka't guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu mar guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ka't guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios; gio ba' tu' jix duu gu Abraam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu tanoolh ka't guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Isaak.
Jano' ba' jix ñi' gu Saara gu mar gu Agar gu Egipkia ka't guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Abraam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.

Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Abraam; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios dhi' ja'tkam na tu juan gu mar; na gu mar dhi' ja'tkam na tu juan cham tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bɨɨx gu mar bɨɨx gu Isaak.
Jano' ba' dhi' tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Abraam kuiñcha gu mar.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Abraam; gio ba' cham tu' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa kuiñcha guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ja'tkam na tu juan; na gu' bɨx tu' tu ñi'ook gu Saara guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu ñi'ook na gu' gu Isaak tu' ka't mɨmɨim gu ma'nkam.
Na gu' gio gu mar ja'tkam na tu juan guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu ja'tkam na gu' gu kai'.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Abraam jix búup guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu xibh jix bhɨɨ gu takarui' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu suudai' jix maa gu Agar guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bhaan guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ do'ñcho guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' ta'tak guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm oidha' jix gaki gu Beer-seba.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu suudai' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨtaa'n gu u'u.

Jano' ba' ka't jix daa guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm na ja'p gu Tiro u'u gat; na gu' chɨtda; na pai' dhuuk cham guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; jano' ba' jix daa guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim.

Jano' ba' jix kai gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jup tɨɨt gu Agar dɨr gu tɨkɨr jix aa'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Agar cham jum i'obh; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' naak gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam pai'.
Na gu' bamii' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu novɨ na gu' gu ja'tkam no'ñ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix kupi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu vupui jix ñi' suudai' buusñi gu suudai'; gio ba' ka't jix bhuup guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu suudai' jix maa i'i guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ oidha' jix gaki ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ u'u gat.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ oidha' jix gaki gu Paraan; gio ba' gu naan jix bhɨɨ gu u'vɨ gu oidha' gu Ejipto.

Ba' jix aa' ka't mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Abimelek gu Pikol gɨ'kora' ja'tkam ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Abraam bham; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios bɨndak bɨx guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' jano' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan Dios cham guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga tu' gu mar tu' gu ja'tkam; gu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jurtu'nka' joi'gɨ'nda' tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨndak jix duu tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bɨɨx gu oidha' pai' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.
Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Abraam; gio ba' tu' ñi'ook kavɨk aa'.
Jano' ba' gu Abraam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Abimelek kuiñcha oidha' suudai' gu suudai' tu duukam gu Abimelek guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.

Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Abimelek; gio ba' cham tu' chɨkka ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam dhi' tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ maachim tu' naak bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Abraam kakneer guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam jix maa gu Abimelek; gio ba' tu' jix duu guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ ñi'ook na jix bhaan.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu Abraam kɨɨv ali' karneer kakneer dɨlhkob.
Ba' jix aa' gu Abimelek gu Abraam; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn kɨɨv ali' karneer guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam dɨlhkob.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; na dhi' kɨɨv ali' karneer guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu novɨ na ba' ka't chuut tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ dhi' oidha' suudai'.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm dhi' jup tɨɨt mii' dhɨr pai' gu Beer-seba; na gu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.
Jano' ba' jix duu ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Beer-seba; gio ba' jix búup gu Abimelek gu Pikol gɨ'kora' ja'tkam ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham suulh gu oidha' gu Pilisteos.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu Abraam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Beer-seba tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Abraam gu oidha' gu Pilisteos mui'x gu tanoolh.
Ba' jix aa' ka't mi' dhɨr dhi' tu'x vaak zel gu Jawatan Dios gu Abraam; gio ba' gu Abraam; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jano' gu mar guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Isaak guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu oidha' gu Moria guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ maa'nkar tai bhaan bhaan maa'n gu kakkavɨk tu' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' gu Abraam jix búup guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu xibh guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim buur jix bhɨɨ baidhak gook guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Isaak gu mar; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu u'u na ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan jix búup ka't pai' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'.
Jano' ba' vaik gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Abraam gu vupui jix ñi' pai' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Abraam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; gio ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx buur tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Abraam gu u'u maa'nkar tai bhaan jix dhaas bhaan gu Isaak gu mar; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu novɨ gu tai guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; mi' dhɨr jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ tɨtda:―Aañ.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Isaak gu Abraam gu taat; gio ba' gu taat guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu mar; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu Miren gu tai gu u'u; gu' duukat mar kaneer na ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan.

Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Abraam; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam mar kaneer na ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu mar guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga tɨtda:―Aañ.

Jano' ba' jix duu na ja'p guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam pai' gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook gu Abraam jodai maa'nkar Jawatan guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu u'u guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu Isaak gu mar jix dhaas jodai maa'nkar Jawatan bhaan gu u'u.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Abraam gu novɨ jix bhɨɨ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam na ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu mar.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix maa jiiñak gu tɨkɨr; gio ba' gu Abraam; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu novɨ bhaan guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa cham tu'; na tu' kakasnira' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios cham guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu mar guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Abraam gu vupui tu jiim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm a'aa'; gio ba' ka't gu Abraam jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook makgɨrxi maa'nkar tai bhaan pai' gu mar.

Jano' ba' jup tɨɨt gu Abraam gu tɨɨgɨ' mii' dhɨr pai' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; mi' dhɨr gu kavɨk gu Jawatan Dios ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.
Jano' ba' jup tɨɨt nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Abraam gookim tu jiim dɨr gu tɨkɨr.

Ba' jix aa'; na gu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na gu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam dhi' cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu mar guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn tu' jix bhai' aa' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu kai' na ja'p gu si'avag gu tɨkɨr na ja'p oo' jugii'ñ gu gɨ' suudai'; gio ba' gu kai' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn kiki'ñgob guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.
Na gu' gu kai' ka't guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ chɨbɨɨp gu oidha' na gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Abraam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jix búup jix bɨɨx duu tɨtda:―Aañ gu Beer-seba; gio ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Abraam gu Beer-seba.
Jano' ba' ka't mi' dhɨr dhi' tu'x ka't guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Abraam bham; gio ba' gu Miren gio gu Milka tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu ma'nkam gu Nakôr xibhɨk.
Jano' ba' gu us maa'nkam mar gu Bus xibhɨk gu Kemuel gu taat gu Aram.
Jano' ba' gu Kêsed gu aso gu Pildas gu Jidlap gu Betuel.
Jano' ba' gu Betuel jix mar gu Rebeeka; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Milka gu Nakôr xibhɨk gu Abraam.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Reuuma guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gio gu Teba gu Gaam gu Taas gu Maakâ.
Jano' ba' ka't gu oidha' gu Saara chamaam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu oidha' gu Saara.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu Saara gu Kiriat-arba gu ebroon gu oidha' gu Kanaan; gio ba' suudai' u'va gu Abraam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Saara jix xuaak.
Ba' jix aa' jix búup gu Abraam vupui bhaan jix koi gu ma'nkam gu et bham.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga jix koi vupui bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu et gu Abraam gui'p.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Jawatan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam jix duu gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ no'ch; gio ba' tutkɨ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jix koi; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ no'ch tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix koi.
Jano' ba' gu Abraam jix búup tu' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu ja'tkam mii' dhɨr gu oidha' gu ma'nkam gu et.
Ba' jix aa' bɨɨx bham; gio ba' tu' namki' aagak tu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ jix koi vupui bhaan tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' bɨɨx gu Eproon gu mar gu Soar.

Na ba' na ba' jix maa jumpa'n gu Makpela juraa'n guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu maa'nkar; na guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jir bhai' u'uuk jix maa na ba' gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.

Jano' ba' dhi' gu Eproon gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu et; gio ba' jix aa' gu Eproon gu eteo gu Abraam maatɨt gu ma'nkam gu et bɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ki'ñgob kiicham bham.

Jano' ba' cham gu Jawatan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu maa'nkar tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gio jumpa'n; mi' dhɨr vupui bhaan gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jix koi.
Jano' ba' gu Abraam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios vupui bhaan gu ja'tkam gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Eproon maatɨt gu ja'tkam gu oidha' bham; gio ba' va'k tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ; mi' dhɨr tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ u'uuk gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tu' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga jix koi.
Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Eproon gu Abraam tu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; gio ba' gu oidha' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jix toja jodai; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim dhi' tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jix koi.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Abraam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bɨɨx gu Eproon guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Abraam gu Eproon tuumiñ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu ma'nkam gu et guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jix toja jodai jix bhai' ñi'ook na tu a'ga tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duu.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu maa'nkar gu Eproon ka't gu Makpela guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Mamre gu maa'nkar jumpa'n ka't bɨx gu u'u ka't gu maa'nkar bɨx gu oidha' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Abraam gu maa'nkar ñiata gu ma'nkam gu et bɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ki'ñgob kiicham.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Abraam gu Saara gu u'vɨ jumpa'n gu maa'nkar gu Makpela guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Mamre gu ebroon gu oidha' gu Kanaan.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu maa'nkar jumpa'n ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Abraam gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu ma'nkam gu et.
Jano' ba' gu Abraam ka't guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn xoi'kam kia'mi'ñ gu tanoolh; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios ka't guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Abraam bɨx.

Ba' jix aa' gu Abraam jix duu guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu vaak ka't guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bɨx ga'ra'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jano' gu novɨ bɨtaa'n guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨkɨr gu Jawatan Dios gu oidha' cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu u'vɨ na ba' gu mar ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Kananeos tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.
Gu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu oidha' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu u'vɨ na ba' gu mar gu Isaak.

Jano' ba' jix duu jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu u'vɨ cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tu' dhi' gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu mar gu oidha' pai' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Abraam; gio ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam cham guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu mar.
