Jano' ba' jup tɨɨt gu Faraoon gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Josee gu Sapnat-paanea; gio ba' jix maa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu u'vɨ gu Asenat mar u'vɨ gu Potipera jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan; mi' dhɨr jix buus gu Josee guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx gu oidha' gu Ejipto.

Na pai' dhuuk ka't gu Josee guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ na pai' dhuuk ka't guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat vupui bhaan gu Faraoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto; gio ba' jix buus gu Josee vupui bhaan gu Faraoon guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu oidha' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam kɨɨv guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gɨ' kavɨk.
Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ bɨx jugi kɨɨv guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix bɨɨx duu gu oidha' gu Ejipto guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jugi jɨ'dɨlh guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ kiicham jugi yooxi' xikoolh.

Na gu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Josee tiriik na ja'p oo' gu gɨ' suudai' jix jai' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx ka'm cham jix bhaai' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam na gu' cham ga'ra' jɨɨ'ñdhidha'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Josee gook gu ma'nkam va'k guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn maa'n oidha' tas bhiogi' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Asenat mar u'vɨ gu Potipera jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jup tɨɨt gu Josee gu tɨɨgɨ' maa'nkam mar gu Manasees; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa' jix duu guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bɨx tu jiim bɨx gu vaak gu taat.
Jano' ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gook jup tɨɨt gu Epraim; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa' jix duu guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu oidha' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ kɨɨv guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim ka't gu oidha' gu Ejipto.

Jano' ba' kua'da' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ kɨɨv guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bhiogi' na ja'p gu Josee ka't tu ñi'ook; gio ba' ka't bhiogi' bɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu' bɨx gu oidha' gu Ejipto ka't gu takarui'.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bhiogi' bɨx gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu ja'tkam tu ñi'ook gu Faraoon guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu takarui'; gio ba' jix aa' gu Faraoon bɨx gu Egipkios; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Josee guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn tu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' bhiogi' ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios; gio ba' jano' ba' jix kupi'ook gu Josee bɨx guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ pai' ka't guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Egipkios; na gu' ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bhiogi' gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Na gu' bɨx gu oidha' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Ejipto na ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Josee na gu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx gu oidha' ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bhiogi'.
Ba' jix aa' ñɨi'ñ gu Jakob gu Ejipto ka't guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu ma'nkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tɨɨgɨk.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' naak cham tu'x jai'ch jix duu gu Ejipto; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam na ba' no'ch na ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat duaka' cham vaak jodai.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam mambhɨɨx gu ja'tkam gu Josee guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tiriik gu Ejipto.

Gu' gu' gu Jakob cham bhañ gu Benjamiin xibhɨk gu Josee bɨɨx gu ja'tkam; na gu' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr cham ka't guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tɨjɨɨ'ñ aajidha'; na gu' ka't bhiogi' gu oidha' gu Kanaan.

Jano' ba' gu Josee ka't gu Jawatan gu oidha' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bɨx gu ja'tkam gu oidha'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu ja'tkam gu Josee tu' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu vupui guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm pai'.

Jano' ba' gu Josee na ja'p jix ñi' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; gu' jix duu cham guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam jix aa'; mi' dhɨr duukat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tɨbiap tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu oidha' gu Kanaan guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu Josee guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu ja'tkam; gu' cham guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' tɨ'ñcho gu Josee tɨɨtki' ka't guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tɨbiap.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham gu Jawatan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; gu' tu duukam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tɨbiap guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.
Jano' ba' bɨx no'ch gu'ch gu ma'nkam gu chio'ñ; gio ba' gu'ch gu chichio'ñ tu'r; mi' dhɨr tu duukam cham pai' dhuuk jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' cham; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tɨbiap.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu duukam gu'ch guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu chio'ñ gu oidha' gu Kanaan; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jix ali' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bɨɨx chulhiiñdha' gu taat cham guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.
Ba' jix aa' gu Josee; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' dhi' boopoya' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam; na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Faraoon cham guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat na pai' dhuuk xibhɨk jix ali' daraibu'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm maa'n guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa xibhɨk; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa ui'ka' gu ñi'ook ka't guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu' cham tu'x jai'ch tu'r bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; mi' dhɨr tu' cham guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Faraoon guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ kuupa' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm vaik gu tanoolh.
Ba' jix aa' vaik gu tanoolh gu Josee; gio ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn dhi' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ; mi' dhɨr tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' tu' gu chichio'ñ tu'r guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ kuupka' gu vaak kuupa' maa'n gu ja'tkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jugi na ba' bhiogi' gu vaak.
Gu' gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ xibhɨk jix ali' ka't guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu ñi'ook cham koi; gio ba' jix duu.

Jano' ba' am:―Ja'pji maa'n; na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ uañi'ñ bhaan chulhiiñdha' xibhɨk guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu i'ii'ñ na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' tɨbiap bhaan no'ch dhi' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Rubeen jix aa' bham; gio ba' cham tu ñi'ook tu'; mi' dhɨr cham guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bhaan guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ; jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Miren gio gu ɨ'ɨr guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga.
Na gu' cham guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Josee na gu' ka't guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix ai'chdhix guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim; gio ba' mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tu ñi'ook jix bhɨɨ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Simeoon guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios ñiata.

Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix gu Josee guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tiriik guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tuumiñ maa'n guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jugi na ba' gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' tu' jix duu bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas tiriik bhaan buur jix bɨɨx duu.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ maa'n guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios na ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jugi buur guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jix ñi' tuumiñ ka't gu chin guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Ba' jix aa' gu ja'tkam; gio ba' tuumiñ tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios; mi' dhɨr daam jano' ba' gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gui'p maa'n; jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim dhi' tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Jakob gu taat gu oidha' gu Kanaan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bɨx ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bham.
Ba' jix aa' mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan gu oidha' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios na ja'p guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' no'ch tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu'ch gu chichio'ñ tu'r cham pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' gu'ch guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ja'tkam gu ma'nkam chulhiiñdha' gu taat; gio ba' maa'n cham guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jix ali' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bɨɨx chulhiiñdha' gu taat gu oidha' gu Kanaan.

Ba' jix aa' mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan gu oidha'; gio ba' dhi' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu chichio'ñ tu'r; mi' dhɨr tɨtda:―Cha'pim guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam maa'n gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn na ba' bhiogi' gu vaak guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam xibhɨk jix ali' na ba' tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim cham guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu chichio'ñ tu'r; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ xibhɨk guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' ka't guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios maa'n ka't gu ñi'ook tuumiñ; gio ba' ñɨi'ñ gu taat gu ñi'ook tuumiñ chooto'n choo'n.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu taat gu Jakob; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu ma'nkam; mi' dhɨr gu Josee cham guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu' gu Simeoon guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Benjamiin guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios; jano' ba' bhaan tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ dhi' tu'x.
Ba' jix aa' gu Rubeen gu taat bham; gio ba' jix duu koi gook gu ma'nkam tu' cham tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu novɨ tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tu'.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu mar bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; na xibhɨk jix koi guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu bhóogɨt guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm pai' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.
Jano' ba' bhiogi' ka't jix gɨ' gu oidha'.
Ba' jix aa' ka't na ja'p jix bɨɨx duu jugi tiriik aichdhak gu Ejipto gu taat; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam na ba' no'ch guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn jugi.

Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Judaa bham; gio ba' mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bɨɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bham; mi' dhɨr cham chɨgia' gu vupui cham xibhɨk bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.
Jano' ba' tu' tɨip chulhiiñdha' xibhɨk bɨɨx no'ch guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam jugi.
Gu' gu' tu' cham tɨip cham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; na gu' mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ jix aa'; mi' dhɨr cham chɨgia' gu vupui cham xibhɨk bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.

Ba' jix aa' gu Israeel; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam cham bhai' jix duu gu chio'ñ ga'ra' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ xibhɨk.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ tɨtda:―¿Jax guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm no'ch guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bham; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu taat namki' xibhɨk guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jurtu'nka' dhi' gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ no'ch maachim ka't guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ xibhɨk.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Judaa gu Israeel gu taat; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios cham vaak jodai no'ch tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ a'aalh.

Jano' ba' gu Yo guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam; mi' dhɨr tu' cham tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn vupui bhaan tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam na ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨx gu tanoolh.
Na tu' cham guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ tɨɨda' jano' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gook mui'kim.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Israeel gu taat jix aa'; na gu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tutkɨ gu oidha' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn suudai' na jix bhai' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu noobh guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tuumiñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu novɨ tuumiñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn ka't guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gio xibhɨk guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Omnipotente jix maa i'ii'ñ na jix xoi'kam vupui bhaan mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn xibhɨk dhi' gu Benjamiin; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu novɨ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tuumiñ gu Benjamiin; gio ba' jix búup guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Ejipto guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm vupui bhaan gu Josee.

Ba' jix aa' jix ñi' gu Josee gu Benjamiin bɨɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu vaak; gio ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu vaak guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; na gu' dhi' ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ jugi guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tanoolh.
Ba' jix aa' jix duu gu chio'ñ na ja'p gu Josee; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ gu chichio'ñ gu vaak gu Josee.

Na pai' dhuuk mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ chooto'n choo'n na pai' dhuuk jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu vaak gu Josee am:―Ja'pji; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tuumiñ ka't guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam na ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bhaan no'ch guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bhaan no'ch guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu duukam no'ch guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ buur.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu vaak gu Josee tu ñi'ook ba'k gu vaak.

Jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam no'ch guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu'r guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gɨ'kora' ja'tkam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.

Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p sɨlh guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tuumiñ maa'n ka't gu chin guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn chulhiiñdha' tuumiñ jir bhai' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu noobh.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gio guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu noobh tuumiñ na ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ; gio ba' no'ch cham guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ chɨkka ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam chulhiiñdha' tuumiñ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.

Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' bhai'x i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat cham ɨɨbhi'ñdha'; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios gu taat jix maa chumñigam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; jano' ba' tuumiñ suudai' u'va tu'; gio ba' jix buusñi gu Simeoon.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ gu vaak gu Josee; gio ba' jix maa gu suudai' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tɨɨt; mi' dhɨr jix maa jugi buur.
Na gu' tu jiim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kapbhai' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Josee tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tanoolh na gu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat naak guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jugi gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu Josee gu vaak aichdhak guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ko'kmarak gu novɨ tu jiim gu vaak tu' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bɨɨx ka'm gu oidha'.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' tɨtda:―¿Jax gu ñi'ook mi'p; gio ba' gu taat gɨ' ja'tkam na jix maat tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn xoi'kam guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' xoi'kam tu' tu duukam chulhiiñdha' gu taat; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; jano' ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios tu' jix duu guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.

Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu vupui jix ñi' gu Benjamiin xibhɨk gu mar gu naan; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam xibhɨk jix ali' tu ñi'ook jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch tu' gu mar guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.

Na gu' jano' ba' gu Josee guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam na gu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam ba'k kuiñcha xibhɨk guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn pai' jix xuaak; gio ba' chɨbiapui guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim.
Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu vupui jix buus mai' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; gio ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu takarui'.

Jano' ba' jix dhaas na ba' dɨlhkob guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam na ba' dɨlhkob na ba' gu Egipkios bɨɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; na gu' gu Egipkios cham jɨ'xdha' jugi gu takarui' bɨɨx gu ebreos guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Egipkios.

Jano' ba' jix dhadhaa vupui bhaan jix gɨ' jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jix ali' jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' mi'p mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios maa'n.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ koi' vupui bhaan na ba'; gu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Benjamiin ka't jixchamaam mui'kim na ja'p no'x; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bɨɨx.

Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix gu Josee guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu vaak bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tuumiñ maa'n gu chin guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim vaaso jix toja jodai gu chin guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jix ali' bɨɨx tuumiñ tiriik; gio ba' jix duu na ja'p jix aa' gu Josee.
Jano' ba' namkia' gu xibh gu chichio'ñ jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bɨɨx buur.

Ba' jix aa' dhaibu guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim kiicham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ cham guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Josee guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; gio ba' bamii' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu chichio'ñ; na pai' dhuuk jix duu guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios cham bhai' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm xoi'kam.

Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Jawatan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam cham bhai' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.
Ba' jix aa' na ja'p guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn dhi' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu'x cham pai' dhuuk tu jiim xoi'kam tu duukam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tuumiñ bakia' gu chin guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ dɨr gu oidha' gu Kanaan; gio ba' gu ñi'ook dua'ñ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu vaak gu Jawatan jix toja jodai tu' jix uam jodai.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr tu duukam ua'tulhi'ñ bakia' vaaso guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ no'ch duduaka' tu duukam gu Jawatan.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gio jano' ka't jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bakia' ka't tu duukam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat boopoya' cham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix maa guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam maa'n guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu oidha' jix kupi'ook guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; gio ba' dɨr jix gɨ' kua'da' jix bɨɨx duu jix ali'; mi' dhɨr vaaso ka't bakia' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Benjamiin.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ jajannulhi'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat maa'n buur suulh kiicham.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Judaa bɨɨx gu ja'tkam gu vaak gu Josee guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ ka't guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam vupui bhaan gu oidha'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Josee; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu duukam dhi' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam cham guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu chio'ñ na ja'p tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Judaa; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Jawatan guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu ñi'ook bɨɨx guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Jawatan Dios tu' gaagam tu' na cham jir bhai' tu duukam; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm no'ch gu'ch tu duukam gu Jawatan no'ch gio guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios ka't bakia' vaaso.

Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' cham pai' dhuuk tu' tu jiim guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; mi' dhɨr gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios ka't bakia' vaaso ka't tu duukam; jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu taat.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Judaa guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tu ñi'ook tu duukam gu ñi'ook maatɨt gu Jawatan cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bhaan tu duukam tu' jix duu na ja'p gu Faraoon.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan tɨtda:―¿Jax tu duukam bham; gio ba' namki' gu taat xibhɨk.

Jano' ba' no'ch tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan; gio ba' tañia' gu taat gɨ' ja'tkam na jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ jix ali' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; mi' dhɨr xibhɨk guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam jix koi guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu naan gu taat guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook tu duukam; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu vupui bhaan.

Jano' ba' no'ch tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan; na gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ cham jɨ'xdha' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu taat na gu' tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu taat guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook tu duukam; gio ba' tu' xibhɨk jix ali' cham guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat cham guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu vupui.
Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu taat tu duukam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan.
Ba' jix aa' chulhiiñdha' gu taat; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn jugi.

Jano' ba' no'ch tu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn tu'; mi' dhɨr tu' chulhiiñdha' xibhɨk ua'tulhi'ñ bɨɨx no'ch guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; na gu' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu vupui gu chio'ñ cham kua' bɨɨx no'ch chulhiiñdha' xibhɨk jix ali'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' tu duukam gu taat; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gook guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' maa'n jix buus guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tɨɨda' ka't guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bɨɨx ka'm jano' cham buupui.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gio guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam vupui bhaan tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Na pai' dhuuk jano' na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tu' tu duukam gu taat guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ cham ua'tulhi'ñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam na ja'p gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu i'ii'ñ.

Na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ na pai' dhuuk cham guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' tu duukam jix duu guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu duukam chulhiiñdha' gu taat bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Jano' ba' na ja'p tu duukam jix buus guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bɨɨx gu taat bham; gio ba' tu' cham tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ na ba' gu taat bɨx gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ jano' tu duukam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu duukam gu Jawatan guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bɨɨx gu ja'tkam.
Na gu' na gu' gu ñi'ook jix duu tu' gu taat cham guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ cham guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm cham guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn cham bhai' daam gu taat.

Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga tu' gu Josee tu jiim vupui bhaan bɨx mi'p guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tu ñi'ook; gio ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bɨx; mi' dhɨr cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn soo'mchulhdhak bɨɨx jix duu jix maati' gu Josee gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix maa jix xuaak gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Egipkios jix kai gio gu vaak gu Faraoon.

Ba' jix aa' gu Josee gu ja'tkam; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Josee; na gu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu taat gu ja'tkam cham guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tu ñi'ook na gu' mi'p guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam vupui bhaan.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Josee gu ja'tkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jano' tu'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Josee xibhɨk guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ na ba' gu Ejipto.

Jano' ba' jano' cham guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu oidha' bhañ gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.

Na tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gook guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bhiogi' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jixchamaam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tu' oraa'.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios bhañ vupui bhaan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat na ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu oidha' na ba' jix duu gu oidha' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix gɨ' dodhia'.

Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu taat gu Faraoon guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan bɨx gu vaak guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bɨx gu oidha' gu Ejipto.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu taat ja'xñi; gio ba' tu ñi'ook gu mar gu Josee; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan bɨx gu Ejipto; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu' cham tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu oidha' gu Goseen dhi' mia'n tu' gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bɨx guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.

Na gu' tu' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jixchamaam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bhiogi' na gu' cham guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gampai' tu' gu vaak bɨx guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu vupui guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu vupui xibhɨk gu Benjamiin gu chin tu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ maachim gu taat bɨx gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Ejipto bɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ buupui; gio ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu taat guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhaan baakux gu Benjamiin xibhɨk guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim; gio ba' gio gu Benjamiin guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bhaan baakux.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bɨx gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bhaan; gio ba' mi' dhɨr gu ja'tkam tu ñi'ook bɨɨx.

Jano' ba' jix kai guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu vaak gu Faraoon bham; gio ba' gu ja'tkam gu Josee guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tɨbiap; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu vupui gu Faraoon tu duukam.

Ba' jix aa' gu Faraoon gu Josee; gio ba' tu' gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn dhi'; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu vaakax tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu oidha' gu Kanaan.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu taat guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jix duu tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix bhai' gu oidha' gu Ejipto jugi guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim; gio ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn dhi'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu oidha' gu Ejipto guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam na ba' a'aalh gu u'vɨ; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu taat jix duu.
Na gu' cham jix maa cham tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa na gu' xoi'kam gu oidha' gu Ejipto ka't.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' jix maa gu Josee guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Faraoon guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix duu na ba' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' maa'n bɨx jix maa guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jajannulhi'ñ gu Benjamiin jix maa vaik guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ jix toja jodai jixchamaam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jajannulhi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu taat bhañ dhi'; gio ba' mambhɨɨx buur gu ñi'ook tutkɨ gu Ejipto mambhɨɨx buur gu ñi'ook tiriik gu takarui' jugi na ba' gu taat gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr cham guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Ejipto guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu oidha' gu Kanaan gu Jakob gu taat.

Jano' ba' jix maa guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bham; gio ba' gu Josee guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan bɨx gu oidha' gu Ejipto; jano' ba' gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; na gu' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu ñi'ook gu Josee ka't tu ñi'ook; gio ba' ñɨi'ñ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Josee guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam na ba' jix duu gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jakob gu taat guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Israeel; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; mi' dhɨr gu Josee gu mar guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim va'k tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.
Jano' ba' ta'tak gu Israeel bɨɨx bɨx ga'ra' suudai' u'va gu Beer-seba makgɨrxi makgɨrxi'ñdha' gu Jawatan Dios gu taat gu Isaak.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu tukaa'; gio ba' gu Jakob; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios gu taat; na gu' cham jum i'obh guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Ejipto na gu' tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨndak gu Ejipto tu' gio tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ; gio ba' gu Josee guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu novɨ bhaan gu vupui.

Jano' ba' jix búup gu Jakob gu Beer-seba; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu taat gu Jakob a'aalh gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Faraoon ka't guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ na ba' jix duu.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga ka't guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu oidha' gu Kanaan tɨɨtɨs gu Ejipto gu Jakob bɨx gu kai' baidhak.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam baidhak; gio ba' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu ma'nkam bɨx gu kai' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam baidhak gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel baap gu Ejipto gu Jakob gu ma'nkam; gio ba' gu Rubeen maa'nkam mar gu Jakob.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen; gio ba' gu anok gu Pallu gu esroon gu Karmi.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Simeoon; gio ba' gu Jemuel gu Jamiin gu Oad gu Jakîn gu Soar gu Sauul gu mar gu Kananea.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Lebii; gio ba' gu Gersoon gu Koat gu Merari.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Judaa; gio ba' gu Er gu Onaan gu Sela gu Pares gu Sara; gu' gu Er gu Onaan jix koko' gu oidha' gu Kanaan; jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Pares jix bɨɨx duu gu esroon gu amul.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Issakâr; gio ba' gu Tola gu Pua gu Job gu Simroon.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Sabuloon; gio ba' gu Sered gu Eloon gu Jaleel.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Leea guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jakob gu Padan-aram guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn mar u'vɨ gu Dina; gio ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ vaik gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu ma'nkam tu' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Gad; gio ba' gu Sipioon gu Aggi gu Esboon gu Suni gu eri gu Arodi gu Areli.

Ba' jix aa' gu Josee; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Omnipotente jix ñi'ñ gu tasi' gu oidha' gu Kanaan jix bhai' aa'.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn tu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ dhi' gu oidha' gu kai' mi' dhɨr tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' jano' gook gu ma'nkam gu Epraim gu Manasees tu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu oidha' gu Ejipto va'k guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tu' gu oidha' gu Ejipto guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; gio ba' na ja'p gu Rubeen gu Simeoon ka't guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ ka't guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ja'tkam ka't mɨmɨim dɨppɨr.

Na pai' dhuuk na gu' na pai' dhuuk tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Padan-aram jix koi gu Rakêl gu oidha' gu Kanaan gu bhóogɨt na ja'p ɨraab guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu oidha' bai'ñpu' gu Eprata; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu bhóogɨt gu Eprata gu Betleem.
Ba' jix aa' jix ñi' gu Israeel gu ma'nkam gu Josee; gio ba' chɨkka suulhgia'.
Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Josee gu taat; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jano' tu' jix bhai' aa'.

Jano' ba' gu vupui gu Israeel mi'p guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ cham guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; gio ba' jix duu guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga.

Ba' jix aa' gu Israeel gu Josee; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu vupui guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gio gu kai'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Josee jix buusñi tɨjɨɨ'ñ kɨkbok tu' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Josee guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Epraim kɨɨ'n guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Israeel; gio ba' gu Manasees o'nsop jix duu gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr tu' jix duu guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Israeel guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios kɨɨ'n jix dhaas bhaan mo'o gu Epraim ka't jix ali' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bhaan mo'o gu Manasees guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu noobh guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Manasees ka't maa'nkam mar.

Ba' jix aa' jix bhai' aa' gu Josee; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tattat gu Abraam tu' gu Isaak gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn dɨr tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bɨɨx ka'm dhi' gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' gu Angel guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx cham bhai' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam dhi' ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' ka't tɨɨgim gu tɨɨgɨ' tattat gu Abraam tu' gu Isaak; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ gu Josee gu taat guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu novɨ jix duu bhaan mo'o gu Epraim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ dhi' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu novɨ gu taat na ba' jix duu bhaan mo'o gu Epraim mo'o gu Manasees.
Ba' jix aa' gu Josee gu taat; na gu' cham gu taat guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam na gu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam maa'nkam mar; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ kɨɨ'n bhaan mo'o.

Ba' jix aa' gu' gu taat cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; gio ba' tu' gu mar guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tu'; mi' dhɨr gio ɨlhdham guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu ja'tkam ka't gio guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; gu' xibhɨk jix ali' ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix gɨ' gu kai' ka't guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios chɨbɨɨp.

Ba' jix aa' jix bhai' aa' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh bham; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Israeel bham; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p gu Epraim na ja'p gu Manasees; jano' ba' jix dhaas gu Epraim vupui bhaan gu Manasees.

Ba' jix aa' gu Israeel gu Josee; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu oidha' tattat.
Jano' ba' tu' jix maa tu' baasɨ'n bhaan gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu' gu novɨ gu Amorreo bɨɨx gu kuchii bɨɨx u'u gat.
Ba' jix aa' jup tɨɨt gu Jakob gu ma'nkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tu' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios jix duu gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ma'nkam gu Jakob; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu taat gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' gu Rubeen tu' jix duu maa'nkam mar gu kavɨk gɨ'kora' ja'tkam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; gio ba' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gɨ'kora' ja'tkam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn na ja'p gu suudai' cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; na gu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios dhim gu taat; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa dhaibu'.
Jano' ba' gu Simeoon gu Lebii gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' na cham jir bhai' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ɨxchuixim cham tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu i'ii'ñ tu' nɨidhat guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam chu'p; na i'iich guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu chio'ñ aagak guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn vaak jodai.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa i'iich ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ; mi' dhɨr tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Jakob guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' gu Judaa guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu novɨ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios; mi' dhɨr gu ma'nkam gu taat guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios tu'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ maavɨt gu Judaa; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu mar guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ na ja'p maavɨt na ja'p maavɨt guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn; jano' ba' chɨkka guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' cham ka't guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Judaa guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Silo; gio ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bhuru'x guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu mar buur guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ suudai' u'va tɨi'chu' gu ɨ'ɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.
Jano' ba' gu vupui guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios suudai' u'va guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bii'm.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu gɨ' suudai' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ ka't na ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; gio ba' gu oidha' bɨɨx ka'm gu Sidoon.
Jano' ba' gu Issakâr buur guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam baas tɨjɨɨ'ñ gook guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.

Jano' ba' jix ñi' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ ka't jix bhai' gu oidha' ka't guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; gio ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim namki'ñdha'.
Jano' ba' gu Dan guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu ja'tkam na ja'p bopxi'ñ gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' ka't gu Dan gu ko'oi ju'ñdharan gu bhóogɨt guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios ju'ñdharan guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.
Jano' ba' tulhiiñdha' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Gad ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; gu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu Aser ka't tu jiim maa'n guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ ja'tkam na tu juan tɨtda:―Cha'pim maa'n tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Josee guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ ju'ñdharan suudai' buusñi guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhaan vaak jodai.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam u'u gat.

Gu' gu' u'u gat guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu kavɨk guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu noobh guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu noobh jix kavɨk gu Jakob bipia'dam gu jodai gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu taat tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Omnipotente tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu tɨkɨr jiix bɨɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ jix dhaam suudai' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bɨɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu taat jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm gu oidha' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam ka't bhaan mo'o gu Josee bhaan guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Nasareo gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' gu Benjamiin guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; gio ba' gu xibh guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu xumai guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.

Jano' ba' bɨx dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bopxi'ñ gu Israeel; gio ba' dhi' ka't gu taat jix aa' jix bhai' aa'; mi' dhɨr maa'n guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ jix bhai' aa'.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bɨɨx gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bɨɨx tattat jumpa'n yooxi' gu Eproon gu eteo.
Jano' ba' jumpa'n yooxi' gu Makpela vupui bhaan gu Mamre gu oidha' gu Kanaan guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Abraam bɨɨx yooxi' gu Eproon gu eteo na ba' gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Abraam gu Saara gu u'vɨ; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Isaak gu Rebeeka gu u'vɨ; mi' dhɨr gio guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios tu' gu Leea.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam yooxi' jumpa'n ka't gu ma'nkam gu et.

Jano' ba' na ja'p jix bɨɨx duu gu Jakob guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tɨɨt guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jix duu; gio ba' ka't guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bɨɨx tattat.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Josee bhaan gu vupui gu taat guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bhaan guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.
Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix gu Josee guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu taat; gio ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Israeel.

Na gu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ oo'm gu tanoolh na gu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu tanoolh guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Egipkios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu tanoolh.
Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu tanoolh guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Josee gu vaak gu Faraoon bham; gio ba' tu' gaagam jano' nɨidhidha' gu vupui soi'ñ tu ñi'ook maatɨt gu Faraoon bham.

Jano' ba' gu taat guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; mi' dhɨr tukga'n tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ na ba' tu' gu oidha' gu Kanaan guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa; jano' ba' soi'ñ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' jano' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu taat guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.
Ba' jix aa' gu Faraoon; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu taat na ja'p tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Josee jix tɨ'ɨ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu taat; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bɨɨx bɨx tu duukam gu Faraoon daraa gu vaak bɨx daraa gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu vaak gu Josee gu ja'tkam gu vaak gu taat; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu oidha' gu Goseen a'aalh kakneer guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gio bɨɨx guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu ja'tkam kavaayo tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix gɨ'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx ka'm ka't gu Atad baasɨ'n gu Jordaan guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bɨɨx jix gɨ' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Josee jix duu gu taat guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kɨɨv gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu oidha' gu Kananeos guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ ka't gu Atad gui'p; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jix gɨ' dhi' gu Egipkios; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim ka't tɨɨgim gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Abelmisraim baasɨ'n gu Jordaan.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ma'nkam bɨɨx bhaan ka't.

Na gu' bhɨɨk gu ma'nkam gu oidha' gu Kanaan guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios jumpa'n yooxi' gu Makpela ka't guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Abraam bɨɨx yooxi' na ba' gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Eproon gu eteo vupui bhaan gu Mamre.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Josee gu Ejipto gu ja'tkam bɨx guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu taat mi' dhɨr ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ gu ja'tkam gu Josee gu taat ka't jix koi gui'p; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Josee maa'n guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bɨx cham bhai' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.
Jano' ba' mɨjɨ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Josee; gio ba' gu taat jix aa'ñdhix va'k koi'm bham.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Josee; na gu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jano' tu' na cham jir bhai' gu ja'tkam uañi'ñ na gu' cham bhai' tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios; na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jano' tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tu' na cham jir bhai' tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu taat; jano' ba' gu Josee guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gio gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam vupui bhaan gui'p; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu duukam.
Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Josee; gio ba' cham ɨɨbhi'ñdha'; mi' dhɨr dhi' tu' pai' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam cham bhai' bhaan tu' gu' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim xoi'kam na ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ na ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu oidha' jix jai' gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' jano' cham guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ ɨɨbhi'ñ; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu ma'nkam; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' juruuñ gu Josee gu Ejipto gu vaak gu taat; gio ba' jix oidha' gu Josee chamaam mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' jix ñi' gu Josee gu ma'nkam gu Epraim bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ jix duu; gio ba' gio gu ma'nkam gu Makîr gu mar gu Manasees jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bhaan kɨkbok gu Josee.

Ba' jix aa' gu Josee gu ja'tkam; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu oidha' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Abraam gu Isaak gu Jakob.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Josee gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bham; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ o'oo.

Jano' ba' jix koi gu Josee guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn chamaam mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Ejipto.
